;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Battle of Mosul (2016–17)]]
**Iraqi Prime Minister [[Haider al-Abadi]] declares the battle for [[Mosul]] over, after the majority of [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] militants were defeated. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-middle-east-40558836 (BBC)]
*[[2017 Amarnath Yatra attack]]
**At least 7 people are killed and 15 injured after gunmen fire upon a pilgrimage bus and a police vehicle, on the 11th day of the [[Amarnath Temple|Amarnath Yatra]] pilgrimage in the [[India]]n city of [[Anantnag]]. The attack is believed to be [[Terrorism in India|terror-related]]. [http://www.ndtv.com/india-news/2-amarnath-yatra-pilgrims-killed-in-terror-attack-in-jammu-and-kashmirs-anantnag-1723037 (NDTV)] [http://indianexpress.com/article/india/two-amarnath-pilgrims-killed-four-injured-in-terror-attack-in-anantnag-kashmir/ (''The Indian Express'')]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[Camden Market#2017 fire|Camden Market fire]]
**A large fire breaks out at the [[Camden Markets]] in North West [[London]], with over 70 firefighters and 10 firetrucks attending the scene. No casualties have been reported. [http://www.smh.com.au/world/massive-fire-engulfs-camden-market-in-london-20170709-gx7x3s.html (''The Sydney Morning Herald'')]
*[[2017 United States Marine Corps KC-130 crash]]
**A [[United States Marine Corps]] [[Lockheed C-130 Hercules]] [[military transport aircraft]] carrying sixteen people has crashed near the American town of [[Greenwood, Mississippi]]. All sixteen bodies have been recovered. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/nation-now/2017/07/10/military-plane-crashes-mississippi/466618001/ (''USA Today'')] [https://www.yahoo.com/news/u-military-plane-crashes-mississippi-least-5-reported-033313522.html?soc_trk=gcm&soc_src=d9780ae9-562b-3ef5-9d83-c17f2088b031&.tsrc=notification-brknews (Reuters via Yahoo! News)]

;Health and medicine
*[[Coffee#Health effects|Health effects of coffee]]
**[[Coffee]] may prolong the [[human]] [[life]]span, suggests one study by [[Imperial College London]] and the [[International Agency for Research on Cancer]], and another by the [[Keck School of Medicine of USC]]. [http://www.cnn.com/2017/07/10/health/coffee-leads-to-longer-life-studies-reaffirm/index.html (CNN)]

;International relations
*[[Doklam#2017 Doklam crisis|2017 Doklam crisis]]
**Amid a stand-off between [[India]] and [[China]] over the disputed territory of [[Doklam]] which is claimed by [[Bhutan]], the [[Indian National Congress]] denies the meeting of [[Rahul Gandhi]] with the Chinese ambassador to India. [http://zeenews.india.com/india/amid-india-china-stand-off-on-doklam-congress-denies-rahul-gandhis-meeting-with-chinese-envoy-luo-zhaohui-2022528.html (Zee News)]

;Law and crime
*[[List of major crimes in Ireland|Crimes in Ireland]]
**A 3 year-old boy is stabbed to death in an incident in the Poddle Park area of [[Kimmage]] in [[Dublin]], [[Republic of Ireland|Ireland]]. The child's mother, believed to be an Iranian national, is being treated for knife wounds in hospital. [https://www.rte.ie/news/ireland/2017/0711/889269-kimmage-dublin/ (RTÉ)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Mongolian presidential election, 2017]]
**[[Battulga Khaltmaa]] is sworn in as the new [[President of Mongolia]] following his victory in the second round presidential election on 7 July. [http://english.sina.com/news/2017-07-10/detail-ifyhweua4683349.shtml (Sina English)]
*[[Human rights in China]]
**The [[Nobel Peace Prize]] [[2010 Nobel Peace Prize|winner]] [[Liu Xiaobo]] is in "critical condition," according to Chinese doctors. [https://www.nytimes.com/2017/07/10/world/asia/liu-xiaobo-china-cancer-abroad.html (''The New York Times'')]
*[[Politics of Israel]]
**[[Avi Gabbay]], former minister of environmental protection in [[Thirty-fourth government of Israel|Benyamin Netanyahu's government]], wins an upset victory in the primaries of the [[Israeli Labor Party]], thus becoming leader of the opposition. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2017-07-10/israel-s-avi-gabbay-wins-upset-victory-in-labor-party-runoff-j4yjs8ee (Bloomberg Politics)][https://www.theguardian.com/world/2017/jul/11/avi-gabbay-hailed-israel-macron-labour-leadership-win (''The Guardian'')]

;Science and technology
*''[[The Sixth Extinction: An Unnatural History|The Sixth Extinction]]''
**Between 1900 and 2015, around 177 species of [[mammal]]s have lost 80% of their distribution leading to a presumption that the [[Holocene extinction]] is accelerating. [https://www.wired.co.uk/article/sixth-mass-extinction-humans-animals-conservation (''Wired'')]
